changelog:
- Initial release of the find-skills skill.
- Helps users discover and install agent skills based on their needs or queries.
- Offers guidance on how to search for and present relevant skills using the Skills CLI (npx skills).
- Provides tips for effective skill searches and categories of common tasks.
- Includes fallback suggestions when no relevant skill is found.
summary: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express...
